ns2:course.label: Cognitive Psych Lab
ns2:course.description: Examination of the methods used to study human thought processes, including attention, memory, decision-making, language and concepts. Students will learn to design, carry out, and report research in cognitive psychology. Prerequisite: PSYC 224 or PSYC 248; PSYC 235.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
